messages.subject: Rstan 2.10 installation/compilation issues in Windows
parts:
I get the following error when I run the 8schools.stan example under rstan 2.10.1.

fit <- stan(file = '8schools.stan', data = schools_dat, iter = 1000, chains = 4)
Error in .Call("CPP_stanc280", model_code, model_cppname) : 
  "CPP_stanc280" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)


I installed it with a brand new instance of R 3.3.1 with RStudio 0.99.902 on Windows 7. I have Rtools3.3 installed for my toolchain.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan 2.10 installation/compilation issues in Windows
parts:
On Tuesday, June 28, 2016 at 5:23:38 PM UTC-4, Kevin Rush wrote:
I get the following error when I run the 8schools.stan example under rstan 2.10.1.

fit <- stan(file = '8schools.stan', data = schools_dat, iter = 1000, chains = 4)
Error in .Call("CPP_stanc280", model_code, model_cppname) : 
  "CPP_stanc280" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)

Try

remove.packages("rstan")

and then if

dir(system.file("libs", package = "rstan"))

is anything other than "", manually remove the whole rstan/ folder from your hard disk. Then, restart R making sure that it does not autoload any old stanfit or stanmodel objects from a .RData file and try

install.packages("rstan", dependencies = TRUE)

again.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: Rstan 2.10 installation/compilation issues in Windows
parts:
I had an older version of 8schools.rda in my directory. Deleting this actually and following your advice did the trick.
